description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… “Bella Sol”, a bright and inviting coastal retreat in the heart of Seacrest Beach. This spacious 5 Bed, 5.5 Bath home sleeps 12 and offers everything you need for an unforgettable 30A getaway including 7 bikes, access to the iconic 12,000 sq ft Seacrest Lagoon Pool just a short walk away and community beach access only a 2-minute bike ride away or via seasonal tram. Thoughtfully designed with multiple En-suite bedrooms, welcoming living spaces and several outdoor balconies, “Bella Sol” is perfect for families and groups looking to relax, explore and enjoy the best of 30A all within walking distance of shops, dining and neighboring Rosemary and Alys Beach. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Sleeps 12 with 5 Bedrooms + 5.5 Baths: Spacious En-suite bedrooms throughout provide comfort and privacy for families and groupsPrime Seacrest Beach Location: Walk to Peddler’s Pavilion, shops, dining and live musicAccess to 12,000 Sq Ft Seacrest Lagoon Pool: Resort-style pool with waterfalls, loungers and a family-friendly splash area just a short walk awayCommunity Beach Access + Seasonal Tram: Easy and stress-free beach days with a tram available during peak seasons7 Bikes Included: Explore Seacrest, Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach and nearby favorites with easeMultiple Outdoor Living Spaces: Balconies and porches designed for lounging, dining and enjoying the coastal breezeChef’s Kitchen + Open Living Areas: Ideal for shared meals, gatherings and making memories together*** LIVING AREAS ***The living space at Bella Sol is warm, welcoming and designed for easy coastal living. The open layout brings everyone together whether you’re relaxing after a beach day or enjoying a movie night. Comfortable seating and natural light create an inviting atmosphere that feels like home the moment you arrive.Cozy living area with ample seating and flat-screen TVOpen-concept flow connecting living, dining and kitchen spacesEasy access to the back porch for indoor-outdoor living*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The chef’s kitchen is well equipped and thoughtfully laid out making it easy to prepare meals while staying connected with family and friends. From casual breakfasts to shared dinners this space is designed to bring everyone together.Chef’s kitchen with stainless steel appliances and ample counter spaceBar seating for 4 perfect for quick bites or conversationDining area with seating for 6Half bath conveniently located off the kitchen*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Bella Sol offers several private outdoor spaces to enjoy Florida’s sunshine and coastal breezes. Grill out back, unwind on a balcony or enjoy quiet moments outdoors throughout the day.Back porch with ample outdoor seating and gas grillPrivate balcony off the Primary Suite with lounge seating for 2 and a porch swingFront-facing 2nd-floor balcony with outdoor sectional and lounge seating for 2*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***With 5 bedrooms and 5.5 baths, “Bella Sol” is designed to comfortably accommodate up to 12 guests while offering privacy and relaxation for everyone.1st FloorKing Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with dual vanities and walk-in shower2nd FloorPrimary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, private balcony access and En-suite with dual vanities and oversized walk-in showerQueen Guest Suite: Queen bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity and shower/tub comboQueen Guest Suite: Queen bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity and walk-in showerBunk Room: 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity and shower/tub combo*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Located in the heart of Seacrest Beach, Bella Sol places you steps from some of 30A’s most beloved destinations while offering access to resort-style community amenities.12,000 Sq Ft Seacrest Lagoon Pool: Just a 2-minute walk with loungers, waterfalls and a family-friendly splash areaSeasonal Tram to the Beach: A convenient and breezy ride for easy beach daysCommunity Beach Access: Easy access by bike or tramPeddler’s Pavilion: 5-minute stroll to shops, dining, bike rentals and live musicRosemary Beach: 10-minute walk to cobblestone streets, boutique shopping and coastal diningAlys Beach: 10-minute walk to white architecture, upscale dining and serene courtyards*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independently.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Waiver required to access the 7 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A ESCAPES, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Essentials: Olive Oil and Salt & Pepper Starter Supplies
